objection_dispositions.reason: Named contracts now provide semantics, scales, source bindings, terminal dispositions and exact review obligations for P01-P10. This accepts prospective coherence; implementation, native preflight and freeze remain pending.

Four independent parent-A and four parent-B arms now share the same source-known parent fixture as every A arm. P04 requires baseline/parents/hybrid and an interaction discriminator; physical interaction remains unexecuted.
Both Q arms cap distinct attacks at two. Every P02 attack requires a linked constructed/tested/no_viable_branch disposition. Honest failure closes the obligation without proving constructive gain.

Evaluator-only S1/S2 inventories identify outcome, constraints, ordinary observations, anomaly, disturbances, carriers, changeable links, resources and parents. Applicability is prospectively declared; underlying facts were outside this review.
All non-D arms require rival prediction and defeat. Raw qualification separates semantic contract, useful discrimination, support, fit and case-local novelty from structural completion.

Four paired case/repetition blocks and four shared Z outputs are explicit. Concurrent A controls receive equal case/parent inputs. Recurrence is limited to model outputs without independent-Z, seed or field replication claims.

Soft 420/350-word role limits, 22,000-word reviews and a 45,000-word input proxy make burden measurable without compute equivalence. Capacity remains an explicitly pending unscored coverage-preflight gate, not established feasibility.
Raw-first scoring, D-only addition attribution and retention are specified. R02 clarifies how exact review coverage preserves evaluable raw comparisons when D is missing or invalid.

Fixed identical concern/tension inputs isolate convergence timing. Declared neutrality excludes a supplied winning resolution/probe; decision relevance, competing predictions, fit and unresolved contradictions replace disagreement length.
Five selected historical diagnostic pairs and untouched K1/K2 are labeled separately. Historical D stays evaluator-only, and compressors have identical raw inputs within each pair.

Scales, stable ordinary ordering, fallback, unresolved gates and uncertain-family links are explicit. R01 resolves a qualification mismatch between retained_qualification and the P10 eligibility list.

Identical retained sets and locked assessments, entering/displaced scores, violations and burden are required. Visibility gain is acknowledged as partly imposed by the rule; better human decisions are excluded.

The matrix has 112 main review rows, eight P08 rows and fourteen P09 rows: 134 total, exactly two per declared unit/pair. References resolve to schedule IDs; candidate obligations expand after first save. Eight calls alone do not prove coverage.

Opaque IDs, counterbalanced order and residual semantic recognizability are explicit. Disputes preserve agreed scalars, compare co-membership rather than labels, forbid guessed merges and retain unresolved disagreement after bounded adjudication.

Counts reconcile: 100 main plus 16 critique plus eight P08 plus fourteen P09 roles equals 138; 48 main plus eight critique workflows equals 56; 120 historical plus 56 fresh sets equals 176. Three schema and two review preflight roles are separate.

All ten contracts remain required. At most three finite design rounds and zero scored retries prevent indefinite expansion; downstream interventions retain fixed-input comparisons rather than factorial crosses.
Synthetic stipulations, model proposals/assessments and deterministic presentation outcomes remain distinct. Physical, operational, human-decision and field effectiveness are explicitly unexecuted.

remaining.issue: criteria.json retained_qualification inherits intelligibility and semantic contract met, but p10.eligible lists neither explicitly. A retained new/useful candidate with partial or failed strategy semantics could pass the listed slot gate despite failing retained_qualification.
remaining.repair: Before freeze, either make P10 eligibility reuse retained_qualification plus confirmed distinction from slot one, or explicitly authorize the weaker presentation gate and report affected candidates separately. Reuse locked fields; require no new assessment. Preserve conditional-fit exclusion and unresolved/equivalence gates.

remaining.issue: Main matrix rows expect D among source jobs, while the protocol permits raw evaluation when compression fails. review-contract.json gives an undifferentiated incomplete-review gate. Implementation needs separate coverage states to avoid turning a missing D into missing raw evidence.
remaining.repair: Declare raw and post-stage coverage/completion separately. Require both raw reviews for raw exclusivity; record unavailable D retention/lineage as unobservable or skipped with cause. Gate retained qualification and P10 when post execution or required coverage is incomplete, while preserving valid raw findings and failure denominators.

smallest_unit.definition: One frozen input block with an independently first-saved intervention and its declared comparator, explicit rival/defeat, unchanged outcome/constraints, two terminal raw assessments, stage-specific lineage dispositions and recorded native completion or failure.
smallest_unit.scope: P01 inversion/ordinary; P02 construction/critique; P03 conversion/resistance; P04 hybrid/ordinary/parent A/parent B; P05 backcast/direct; P06 relocation/original carrier; P07 anomaly/ordinary; P08 deferred/immediate convergence; P09 preservation/ordinary Distill; P10 alternative/ordinary ranking.
smallest_unit.count_meaning: 134 counts planned assessment rows, not independent samples or 134 distinct experimental pairs. Shared Z and baseline artifacts recur across those rows. Matrix uniqueness and two-review allocation are prospective bookkeeping findings only.

recomposition.generation: P01-P07 generate or construct distinctions. Evaluate raw A/Q against the named concurrent comparator and ordinary/creative overlap; shared Z overlap is separate. Z reads case only, whereas A also reads parents, so shared Z is an incumbent context rather than an equal-evidence operator comparator.
recomposition.downstream: P08 turns fixed tensions into probes; P09 tests preservation on fixed raw packets; P10 compares exposure from immutable retained sets and locked judgments. Raw gains, D losses/additions, uncertainty, visibility, displacement and known burden remain separate.
recomposition.pipeline: Freeze sources/contracts, first-save independent raw outputs, assess distinctions, trace convergence and compression, lock disputes, compare ranking views, then audit every attempt and source-linked P01-P10 finding. Standalone fixed-input downstream comparisons compose diagnostically; they do not establish a fully combined intervention effect or permit multiplying rates across different fixture populations.

frame_expiry.validity: Prospective contract review only, using the eight authorized design files plus this round prompt. No cases, answers, outcomes, code or effectiveness evidence were examined.
frame_expiry.reopen: Material changes to evidence bindings, arms, scales, qualification, review allocation or failure gates; failed capacity/schema preflight; scored exposure before freeze; or expansion to field or combined-route claims. Preserve stable disagreement and original failed attempts.
frame_expiry.pending: Execution/code tests, native schema and reviewer coverage trials, independent completion audit, and final freeze remain required gates; their absence is not an unknown-code failure.

next_route.action: Resolve R01/R02 in the contracts without dropping any strategy. Implement declared mechanics and complete separate unscored code/schema/coverage preflights; reconcile any necessary budget changes and freeze before scored launch.
next_route.finite_stop: Close design preparation once the explicit rules and declared preflight gates are satisfied, within the three-round ceiling. Proceed to the fixed full P01-P10 schedule; zero scored retries, exact dual coverage, bounded disputes and explicit P10 gates govern closure.
next_route.verdict: Flag for two contract-boundary clarifications; the repaired design is otherwise coherent for implementation. This verdict is neither launch authorization nor evidence of strategy effectiveness.
